test_title: PYST 46: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I am sure you can win the match __if you try hardly__.
solution:
The correct answer is 'if you try hard'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Simple Present Tense.
 
• The structure for a sentence in Simple Present Tense:
 
 
• Structure: Subject + V1 + s/es(if subject is singular) + object
 
• *Example: Emma watches cartoons every day. *
 
 
 
• Also, **hardly** means '**almost no; almost not**'.
 
• And **hard** means '**difficult to do or understand; not easy**'.
 
• Therefore, the underlined segment 'if you try hardly' should be replaced with ' if you try hard ' to make it grammatically correct.

 

Correct sentence:* I am sure you can win the match **if you try hard__**.*
